zh-Hant.title: 常用資訊，點一下就輸入
zh-Hant.body: 鍵盤右側的名片按鈕收著你的地址、電話、Email、身分證字號，一點就輸入；遇到這類欄位，鍵盤上方也會直接建議，全部只存在手機上。注音會記得你選過的字，選完還會建議下一個詞。
zh-Hant.also: 語音潤飾多了「精簡」，不滿意可「換回原文」；語音紀錄可以「修正這個詞」；長按空白鍵移動游標。

en.title: Your saved info, one tap away
en.body: The card button on the right of the keys keeps your addresses, phone numbers, email and ID number one tap away, and matching fields get a suggestion right above the keys, all on your phone. Bopomofo remembers the words you pick and suggests what comes next.
en.also: Voice typing gains a Concise style and Use original; fix a misheard word from your history; hold the space bar to move the cursor.
